svg.aria-label: AETHER system architecture, left to right, with a generation fencing overlay
svg.text: AETHER — Full-Duplex Multilingual Hotel Voice Agent Architecture
Deterministic hotel intelligence with generation-fenced real-time voice execution
1903 tests · 0 stale outputs in 106 recorded runs
BEGIN IMMEDIATE + conditional claim — no double booking
fallback only when route() returns None — never for a stored fact
— a stale generation must never become spoken output (RULES.md R1)
checked BEFORE the tool body runs
a stale booking leaves no row
resolved, then the caller moved on
the row is read, the sentence dropped
a half-spoken answer is not a turn
courtesy to Rime, not the authority
ON THE PHONE, AN INTERRUPTION RUNS:
No ducking on the phone path — it runs hands-free, where voice never ducks and the fence lands at end-of-utterance, not mid-word.
A fenced computation may finish. Its result can never:
✕ leave a booking or order behind
ONE DATABASE → SAME FACTS → THREE RENDERERS
English, Hindi and Spanish read the same row. Only the final template differs, so a
Hindi price cannot drift from an English one. Routing verified 93/93, 31 per language.
THE LLM IS A BRANCH, NOT THE SPINE
Gemini is reached only when the router returns nothing, and never for a price, allergen,
policy, rate or availability. On the committed call, 11 of 16 turns ran at llm_ms = 0.
16 turns · median turn latency 1262 ms · Rime first audio 280 ms · 2 fenced · 0 leaks.
Not measured: STT word accuracy on narrowband audio; two simultaneous callers.
